steps.tx: **Spirochetes** are corkscrews that invade widely and hide for years; **syphilis and Lyme** dominate. **Darkfield** sees live chancre organisms. **RPR with VDRL screen**; **TPPA with FTA confirm**. **Treponemal tests stay lifelong**; activity follows non treponemal titres. A **fourfold fall** proves cure.
steps.say: Spirochetes are corkscrew bacteria that invade widely and hide for years, and syphilis with Lyme cause most disease. Darkfield microscopy sees live organisms from chancres, while blood tests divide into screening with confirmatory pairs. Treponemal tests stay positive for life, so activity is judged by rising non treponemal titres. A fourfold titre fall proves treatment worked.

steps.tx: **Primary chancre** is single, painless and firm edged, healing even untreated. **Shotty groin nodes** accompany it; **darkfield scrapings** confirm in minutes. **Secondary rash on palms and soles** that never itches follows in weeks. **Both stages infect** and both cure with **single dose benzathine penicillin**.
steps.say: Primary syphilis is a single painless chancre with a firm edge that heals even untreated, fooling patients into forgetting it. Shotty groin nodes accompany it, and darkfield examination of scrapings confirms the diagnosis in minutes. Secondary syphilis follows weeks later with rash on palms with soles that does not itch. Both stages are infectious and both are cured by single dose treatment.

steps.tx: **Tertiary syphilis** destroys aorta, brain and skin years later; **gummas** bore palate, shin and liver. **Tabes dorsalis** gives lightning pains, lost reflexes and **Argyll Robertson pupils**. **General paresis** dementias with delusions. **Penicillin still helps** but dead neurons never return to function.
steps.say: Tertiary syphilis is damaging aortas with brains with skin years later, and gummas are boring through palate with shin with liver. Tabes dorsalis wastes posterior columns, giving lightning pains with lost reflexes with Argyll Robertson pupils. General paresis dementing with grandiose delusions completes the quartet. Penicillin still helps, but dead neurons never return.

steps.tx: **Neurosyphilis** strikes any stage: **young stroke, seizures, dementia**. **Spinal fluid** with cells, protein and reactive VDRL confirms; **HIV coinfection** accelerates it. **Intravenous penicillin for 10 to 14 days** treats; lumbar punctures track cure. **Young stroke with dementia** always earns testing.
steps.say: Neurosyphilis is found in any stage and presents with stroke in young adults with seizures with dementia. Spinal fluid with raised cells with protein with reactive VDRL confirms it, and H I V coinfection makes it commoner and faster. Intravenous penicillin for ten to fourteen days is the treatment, with lumbar punctures tracking cure. Every young stroke with every unexplained dementia earns a syphilis test.

steps.tx: **Congenital syphilis** is prevented by **testing every pregnancy twice**; treating mothers cures babies. **Snuffles, rash, liver swelling and fragile bones** mark newborns. **Hutchinson teeth, mulberry molars and keratitis** mark survivors. **Stillbirth with hydrops** follows missed infection; screening is mandatory every pregnancy.
steps.say: Congenital syphilis is prevented by testing every pregnancy twice, because treating mothers cures babies before damage. Snuffles with rash with swollen liver with bones that break describe the infected newborn. Hutchinson teeth with mulberry molars with interstitial keratitis are seen as late stigmata in survivors. Stillbirth with hydrops follows missed maternal infection, which is why screening is mandatory.

points: Test mothers twice, treat early, babies cured
left.title: Screened

points: Missed mothers, stillbirth, stigmata for life
right.title: Missed

steps.tx: **Early syphilis** cures with **single dose benzathine penicillin**; late needs **3 weekly doses**. **Desensitise** allergic patients as penicillin is unmatched. **Jarisch Herxheimer** fever follows first doses as organisms die; warn, never fear. **Partners from past months** traced and treated together.
steps.say: Benzathine penicillin single dose cures early syphilis, while late disease needs three weekly doses to reach hiding bugs. Allergy is handled by desensitisation where possible, because penicillin remains unmatched. Jarisch Herxheimer fever with rigors follows first treatment as dying organisms flood cytokines, and it is warned about, not feared. Partners from the past months are traced and treated together.

steps.tx: **Lyme disease** starts with expanding **erythema migrans** after ticks. **Facial palsy, heart block and meningitis** follow in weeks. **Swollen knees** complete late arthritis. **Doxycycline for 2 to 4 weeks** cures early disease. **Tick removal within a day** prevents transmission; engorgement warns late.
steps.say: Lyme disease starts with expanding erythema migrans after tick bites, and the bullseye spreads over days. Weeks later facial palsy with heart block with meningitis follows as spirochetes disseminate. Months later swollen knees with frank arthritis are ending the triad. Doxycycline for two to four weeks cures early disease, while late arthritis needs longer courses.

steps.tx: **Relapsing fever** returns in waves as variation outruns immunity; **lice spread epidemics, ticks endemic** cases. **Crisis with sweats** ends bouts abruptly. **Smears between fevers** catch hiding bugs. **Tetracycline or erythromycin** aborts attacks. **Delousing with bedding heat** ends epidemics completely and quickly.
steps.say: Relapsing fever returns in waves as antigenic variation outruns immunity, with lice spreading epidemics and ticks spreading endemic cases. Crisis with sweats is ending each bout as abruptly as it began. Blood smears between fevers catch spirochetes that hide during spikes. Tetracycline with erythromycin aborts attacks, while delousing with bedding heat ends epidemics.

steps.tx: **Workup order** is fixed: **darkfield, RPR and confirmatory** tests for ulcers and rashes. **Lyme testing** follows tick exposure with compatible syndromes. **HIV testing** accompanies every syphilis case. **Partners traced** before results return. **Spinal fluid** examined when nerves, eyes or ears involved.
steps.say: Every genital ulcer with every young stroke with every painless rash follows the same testing order. Darkfield with R P R with confirmatory treponemal testing opens syphilis workup, while Lyme testing follows tick exposure with compatible syndromes. H I V testing accompanies every syphilis diagnosis, as coinfection changes pace and proof. Partners are traced before results return.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** chancre is painless; painful ulcers point elsewhere. **Palms and soles** rash never itches. **Jarisch Herxheimer** after first doses is warned, never feared. **Treponemal positive** lifelong never proves activity; RPR guides retreatment. **Young stroke** always earns testing without delay.
steps.say: The traps that fail examinations are calling chancre painful, missing painless rash on palms, and forgetting Jarisch Herxheimer after first doses. Penicillin allergy without desensitisation loses the best drug, and partners untreated reinfect within weeks. Treponemal tests staying positive never proves active disease, so R P R titres guide retreatment. Every young stroke earns a syphilis test.

steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** painless **chancre** with darkfield proof opens syphilis. **Palms and soles** rash never itches. **Single dose** cures early; **3 weekly** late. **Jarisch Herxheimer** follows first doses. **Argyll Robertson** marks tabes. **Erythema migrans** with doxycycline marks Lyme.
steps.say: For the exam, the facts to lock in are painless chancre with darkfield proof, palms and soles rash that never itches, single dose benzathine for early with three for late, Jarisch Herxheimer after first doses, Argyll Robertson pupils in tabes, Hutchinson teeth in congenital, and erythema migrans with doxycycline for Lyme. Treponemal tests stay lifelong while R P R tracks activity. Memorise the facts in this table exactly as written.
